title: Oops!...I Did It Again
description: 《Oops! ...I Did It Again》描寫一段充滿曖昧、誤解與感情遊戲的戀愛關係。歌中的主角發現自己再次讓對方誤以為兩人正在相愛，但她其實並沒有打算認真投入這段感情。她享受被追求與喜歡的感覺，卻也承認自己經常不自覺地玩弄別人的感情。雖然她幻想童話般的浪漫愛情，渴望真正的英雄出現，但現實中的她並不像外表那麼天真無邪。歌曲以輕鬆幽默的方式展現愛情中的矛盾與不成熟。最終，《Oops! ...I Did It Again》傳達的是戀愛中的誘惑、幻想與自我認識：曖昧有時令人興奮，但若沒有清楚表達真實感受，也可能在無意間傷害別人的心。

vocabulary.meaning: 再做一次；又做了同樣的事
vocabulary.usage: 當某件事情已經做過，現在又重複做時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Do it again」？
options: I ate five cakes yesterday, and I did it again today.
I did it again for my brother, so he is now ten years old.
I did it again in my bag, so I found my pencil.
My lunch did it again because it was very hot.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。昨天吃了五個蛋糕，今天又做一樣的事，表示「再次做」。
optionExplanations: 正確。昨天吃了五個蛋糕，今天又做一樣的事，表示「再次做」。
錯誤。do it again 不能表示「讓某人長大」；可以說 My brother is ten now.
錯誤。找東西不能直接用 do it again 表示；應說 I looked in my bag again.
錯誤。午餐不會自己「再做一次」；要說 My lunch was very hot.

vocabulary.meaning: 不只是朋友；關係比普通朋友更親近
vocabulary.usage: 當兩人的關係可能是戀愛關係，而不只是朋友時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「More than just friends」？
options: My shoes are more than just friends because they are new.
Tom and Mia are more than just friends. They are dating.
I ate more than just friends for breakfast.
Our bus is more than just friends because it is late.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。兩人正在約會，關係不只是普通朋友。
optionExplanations: 錯誤。鞋子不是朋友；這個片語是用來描述人與人的關係。
正確。兩人正在約會，關係不只是普通朋友。
錯誤。friends 是人，不能當早餐吃；可說 I ate more than just bread.
錯誤。公車遲到和朋友關係沒有關係；可說 Our bus is late.

vocabulary.usage: 當你喜歡某人，但還不是正式交往時，可以使用 have a crush on + 人。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Have a crush on」？
options: I have a crush on my math test, so I failed it.
She has a crush on the door, so it is open.
We have a crush on the soup because it is too hot.
I have a crush on Sam, but I am too shy to tell him.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。對 Sam 有好感，但害羞不敢說，符合「暗戀」。
optionExplanations: 錯誤。這裡不是在說喜歡某個人；可以說 My math test was hard.
錯誤。開門不能用 crush on；可以說 She opened the door.
錯誤。湯太燙不表示暗戀；可說 The soup is too hot.
正確。對 Sam 有好感，但害羞不敢說，符合「暗戀」。

vocabulary.usage: 根據外表或目前看到的情況做猜測時，可以使用 seem like + 名詞／句子。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Seem like」？
options: That seems like a good idea. Let’s try it!
She seems like to go home at six.
The rain seems like a sandwich today.
I seem like my homework on the table every day.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。用 seem like 表示「聽起來／看起來是個好主意」。
optionExplanations: 正確。用 seem like 表示「聽起來／看起來是個好主意」。
錯誤。seem like 後面不能直接接 to + 動詞；可以說 She seems to want to go home.
錯誤。雨和三明治沒有合理的相似之處；可說 The cloud looks like a sandwich.
錯誤。seem like 不是「放」的意思；可說 I put my homework on the table.

vocabulary.usage: 當你想表明你是真的這樣想，不是在開玩笑時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Be serious」？
options: I am serious my breakfast every morning.
Are you serious? You really bought ten hats for your cat?
He is serious the window because it is cold.
Please serious the music before bed.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。聽到很驚訝的事情時，用 Are you serious? 確認對方是不是認真的。
optionExplanations: 錯誤。be serious 不能直接當作「吃早餐」；應說 I eat breakfast every morning.
正確。聽到很驚訝的事情時，用 Are you serious? 確認對方是不是認真的。
錯誤。serious 不是「關窗戶」；應說 He closes the window.
錯誤。serious 不是動詞，不能這樣使用；可說 Please turn off the music.

vocabulary.usage: 當人不知道自己在哪裡，或不知道該往哪裡走時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Get lost」？
options: I got lost in my sandwich and ate it at noon.
My phone got lost at speaking English.
We got lost in the city, so we asked a man for help.
She got lost the TV because it was funny.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。在城市中找不到方向，所以向人求助。
optionExplanations: 錯誤。吃三明治不能說迷路在三明治裡；應說 I ate my sandwich at noon.
錯誤。get lost 不是「學會說英文」；可說 My phone can speak English.
正確。在城市中找不到方向，所以向人求助。
錯誤。get lost 不能這樣接電視；可說 She watched the funny show.

vocabulary.usage: 當一個人對另一個人有深厚的愛情時，可以使用 be in love (with someone)。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「In love」？
options: I am in love my school bag with a pen.
Nina is in love with Alex. She smiles whenever she sees him.
They are in love the bus at eight.
The pizza is in love because it has cheese.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。in love with + 人，表示 Nina 愛上 Alex。
optionExplanations: 錯誤。in love 不是把筆放進書包；應說 I put a pen in my school bag.
正確。in love with + 人，表示 Nina 愛上 Alex。
錯誤。搭公車不會用 in love；應說 They are on the bus at eight.
錯誤。有起司不表示披薩在戀愛；應說 The pizza has cheese.

vocabulary.usage: 當一個人沒有做錯事，或沒有犯某個被懷疑的錯誤時，可以使用。
options: Leo did not take the money. He is innocent.
I innocent my bike to the park after lunch.
She has an innocent on her desk for writing.
My soup is innocent because I made it with milk.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。Leo 沒有拿走錢，所以是無辜的。
optionExplanations: 正確。Leo 沒有拿走錢，所以是無辜的。
錯誤。innocent 是形容詞，不是騎車的動詞；應說 I rode my bike to the park.
錯誤。innocent 不是文具名稱；可說 She has a pencil on her desk.
錯誤。湯裡有牛奶，不表示湯「無辜」；innocent 通常用來說人。

vocabulary.usage: 當你想請對方暫停，或突然想到一件事時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Wait a minute」？
options: The cake waited a minute and became a dog.
I wait a minute my shoes before school.
Wait a minute! I left my phone at home.
We wait a minute the door so it stays open.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。突然想起手機忘在家裡，用這句請人稍等。
optionExplanations: 錯誤。蛋糕不會因為等一下就變成狗；這個片語是用來要求暫停。
錯誤。wait a minute 不能當作穿鞋；應說 I put on my shoes.
正確。突然想起手機忘在家裡，用這句請人稍等。
錯誤。要說「扶住門」應用 hold the door，而不是 wait a minute.

vocabulary.meaning: 你真貼心／你不必這麼破費（收到禮物時的客氣話）
vocabulary.usage: 別人送你禮物或特別幫你做了好事時，可以用來表示驚喜與感謝。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「You shouldn’t have」？
options: You shouldn’t have! My pencil is under the desk.
I you shouldn’t have my homework every Monday.
You shouldn’t have the bus because it is yellow.
You bought me flowers? You shouldn’t have! Thank you!
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。收到花時客氣地表達感謝，這是很自然的用法。
optionExplanations: 錯誤。鉛筆在桌下不涉及收到禮物；可以說 My pencil is under the desk.
錯誤。You shouldn’t have 是固定句型，不可直接當一般動詞使用。
錯誤。這裡不是說對方做了貼心的事；不能用這句表示公車是黃色。
正確。收到花時客氣地表達感謝，這是很自然的用法。
